title: MEIKO — MORE MORE Training!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Next, Airi and I put our backs together.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I bumped into her after taking too big a step last time, so I need to take smaller ones as I walk backwards...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We did it, Minori!
Let's commit what we just did to memory!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice work, you two!
We have towels and drinks for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, Miku, MEIKO, thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We were watching from over there, and you two looked spectacular. We know that you've all been working very hard lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Lumina Grand Prix's coming up, and it's gonna be our big chance to spread hope to a ton of people. We're willing to do whatever it takes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After all, idols are all about...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Having heart, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, Minori, you thief!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. But that really is a beautiful motto.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it is! After hearing your story, Airi, I also began thinking about how I can have more heart!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, while we're on the subject...! Do you two have any personal mottos for what you do...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, for me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to be an idol forever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Forever...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to keep being an idol for as long as I possibly can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course, there are many paths an idol can take.
Some decide to sear themselves into their fans' memories when they're at their brightest in order to continue lighting up their hearts.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Some may leave the stage for television or radio programs. All are valid decisions in my mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I can think of great idols who fit into each of those categories.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, idols have been giving me hope and encouragement in a lot of different ways until now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Exactly. As for me...
The road I want to take is to stay an idol forever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, I just love idols so much♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I love being an idol, and I love all my fans for giving me so much support.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's precisely why I wish to keep doing this for as long as I possibly can♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's such a great expression of who you are, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...! I'd totally be in tears if I heard you say that during a show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Why don't you tell your fans this during your next one, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
When the right opportunity arises.
But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think they already know how I feel.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If anything, I'd rather communicate all my love by performing for them instead of just telling them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We still have so much to learn.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We gotta do streams and shows in a way that makes our goals as a group clear! Just like MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Airi, can we try practicing that song we just did again? I feel like I can put on a way better performance now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, Miku, MEIKO, can you two give us any advice that comes to mind?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, of course♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since you two are so motivated, I'll be going no holds barred here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No holds barred MEIKO...!
I-I'm ready!
